answer_1.quote: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) is a sophisticated natural language processing task that aims to extract fine-grained sentiment information from text.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates aspect-sentiment quadruples (aspect, category, sentiment, opinion) from input sentences as part of the ASQP task.
